title: Stuck States, Floating Notches, Tracked Type, Wiggly Magnets & Real Selects
description: A CSS-only sticky-state header, a Dynamic-Island floating notch, scroll-driven letter-spacing text reveals, magnetic wiggle buttons, and a fully restyled native select.

drops.title: Stuck State
drops.description: Sticky headers that restyle themselves the instant they become stuck, driven purely by CSS scroll-state container queries.
drops.concept: CSS scroll-state container queries (`@container scroll-state(stuck: top)`) let a sticky element's own container detect and react to its stuck state declaratively — no scroll event listeners, no manual class toggling. It's an experimental but very current browser primitive that finally replaces a decade of JS scroll-position hacks for this exact use case.
drops.source: theosoti.com — 'You can now detect when sticky is actually stuck. In CSS.'

interaction.mouse: Scroll each column to watch its header react
interaction.click: Toggle the debug panel to force the JS fallback path
interaction.touch: Scroll each column with a finger

drops.title: Floating Notch
drops.description: A persistent, edge-pinned pill — Dynamic-Island style — that expands to reveal grouped options and applies them live below.
drops.concept: The Notch pattern keeps a compact row of trigger labels floating at the top edge; tapping one morphs the pill open to reveal that group's options, and picking one updates real page state instantly. It's the same 'always-there control surface' idea behind Apple's Dynamic Island, applied to web settings panels.
tech: CSS custom properties for live theming

interaction.mouse: Click a trigger to open its options, click elsewhere to close
interaction.click: Selecting an option applies it live to the preview card

drops.title: Letter-Spacing Reveal
drops.description: Headlines that tighten from wide letter-spacing to normal as their color resolves, scroll-driven with a per-word stagger variant.
drops.concept: Animating letter-spacing from a wide or negative starting value down to normal — paired with a color transition from transparent to solid — reads as text 'assembling' itself. Bound to `animation-timeline: view()` it becomes a zero-JS scroll-driven reveal; a per-word stagger variant offsets each word's animation-range for a cascading effect.

interaction.mouse: Scroll the panel to trigger each headline
interaction.click: Use the slider to change the starting letter-spacing

drops.title: Wiggle Magnetic Buttons
drops.description: CTAs that ease toward the cursor within a pull radius and spring back on release; some also carry a continuous idle wiggle.
drops.concept: Magnetic buttons lerp their position toward the cursor when it's within a pull radius and relax back to rest when it leaves, giving CTAs a tactile pull. Layering a subtle continuous rotation wiggle on top (on a separate transform layer so the two effects don't fight) adds idle visual energy — with `prefers-reduced-motion` respected throughout.

interaction.mouse: Move the cursor near a button to feel the pull
interaction.click: Adjust strength/radius/wiggle in the debug panel
interaction.touch: Magnetic pull is a mouse-only affordance; buttons remain tappable

drops.title: Customizable <select>
drops.description: Real, fully-accessible native select elements styled top to bottom — including the dropdown popup — with appearance: base-select.
drops.concept: `appearance: base-select` opts a native `<select>` and its `::picker(select)` dropdown out of platform-default rendering into a fully CSS-stylable mode, while keeping native keyboard navigation, screen-reader semantics, and mobile behavior intact. Options can hold arbitrary markup — icons, swatches, descriptions — something previously only achievable with a fake div-based dropdown library.
drops.source: Chrome for Developers — 'The <select> element can now be customized with CSS'

interaction.mouse: Click a select to open its custom-styled dropdown
interaction.click: Choose an option, or change the accent color in the panel
interaction.touch: Tap to open, tap an option to choose
